provenance.instance: Prism TerraFirmaGreg-Modern installed pack; Minecraft 1.20.1; TFG Core Modern 0.9.25; GTCEu 7.5.3
provenance.reference: Existing supplied level.dat WorldGenSettings plus installed mod jars and current KubeJS data/scripts; read-only audit; no Minecraft launch and no save writes.
provenance.resource_merge: Structure/structure-set definitions and Lithostitched modifiers use current KubeJS datapack entries over installed jar resources by resource identifier. Biome tags merge installed jar tag JSON and KubeJS datapack JSON, then replay statically readable KubeJS biome-tag event.add/remove/removeAll operations in sorted script-file and source order. Literal arrays and global.*_BIOMES.forEach loops are expanded; arbitrary JavaScript is not executed. Lithostitched set_structure_spawn_condition defaults append=true (confirmed from the installed 1.4.11 class bytecode), composing successive conditions with AND; append=false replaces. The runtime snapshot independently cross-checks its 27 sets and 63 referenced structures against this broader resource inventory.
provenance.overworld_pool: The saved world uses the custom tfc:overworld biome source. Source eligibility uses the 109 TFG Earth biome IDs registered by current TFG Core 0.9.25 TFGBiomes; the separate 139-ID TFG Earth plus legacy TFC registry-resource superset is retained for audit only. All IDs are raw registry identifiers; vanilla biome names are never aliased to TFC names.
provenance.eligibility: A biome intersection means source-level biome gating can succeed; it does not guarantee placement or terrain viability. `scanner_eligible_dimensions` additionally requires a placement type implemented by the current scanner. Scanner callers should also enforce per-type distance limits (the request is 100 km), frequency, height/terrain checks, and a concrete supported structure ID.
provenance.source_version_note: The older assets/data/tfg/structures.json is from TFG Core 0.9.21 and was not used; current structures and sets were reread from installed TFG Core 0.9.25 KubeJS data and all installed 1.20.1 mod resources.
